name: style-en-gb-academic
about: Style suggestions (BlueEdit's Ctrl+F7, issue #87) on British academic paragraphs, some with LaTeX formulas. A form of its own, next to the grammar sets: problems[] are fragments a good suggestion should change (fragment: exact text; kind: wordiness / officialese / repetition / clarity / passive / informal — informal register is not one of BlueEdit's style focuses yet, measured to decide whether it should be an option); keep[] are facts, terms, numbers, formulas and British spellings that must still be in the paragraph once every suggested change is taken (a missing one means the meaning or the variety changed); problems: [] means a paragraph that reads well, where every change is unneeded. source: made = written for this set.
